description: This file defines the DebugActions enum containing a collection of static methods for debugging and development tasks within the macOS app, such as opening windows, managing logs, restarting services, sending notifications, and performing diagnostics.

methods.name: openAgentEventsWindow
methods.description: Opens a new window displaying agent events, configuring the window's style, title, and content view.

methods.name: openLog
methods.description: Opens the log file in the system's file viewer, or shows an alert if the log file is not found.

methods.name: openConfigFolder
methods.description: Opens the configuration folder in the system's file viewer.

methods.name: openSessionStore
methods.description: Opens the session store file or folder, resolving the path from configuration or defaults.

methods.name: sendTestNotification
methods.description: Sends a test notification asynchronously.

methods.name: sendDebugVoice
methods.description: Sends a debug voice message and awaits a response, returning success or failure.

methods.name: restartGateway
methods.description: Restarts the gateway depending on the current connection mode, managing local and remote modes.

methods.name: resetGatewayTunnel
methods.description: Resets the SSH tunnel if in remote mode, re-establishing the control tunnel.

methods.name: pinoLogPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the log file.

methods.name: runHealthCheckNow
methods.description: Triggers an immediate health check refresh.

methods.name: sendTestHeartbeat
methods.description: Sends a test heartbeat request and returns the event or error.

methods.name: verboseLoggingEnabledMain
methods.description: Returns whether verbose main logging is enabled based on UserDefaults.

methods.name: toggleVerboseLoggingMain
methods.description: Toggles the verbose main logging setting and requests an update remotely.

methods.name: restartApp
methods.description: Restarts the application by relaunching the bundle.

methods.name: restartOnboarding
methods.description: Resets onboarding state and restarts onboarding process.

methods.name: resolveSessionStorePath
methods.description: Determines the session store path from configuration, default, or fallback.

methods.name: recentSessions
methods.description: Fetches recent sessions up to a specified limit.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Updates session metadata such as thinking and verbose levels.

methods.name: checkGatewayPorts
methods.description: Diagnoses gateway port status.

methods.name: killProcess
methods.description: Attempts to terminate a process by PID, first gracefully then forcefully.

methods.name: openSessionStoreInCode
methods.description: Opens the session store file in Visual Studio Code.
